title: Quarter Machine Oracle
style: jazz, big band, authentic jazz, international jazz, brass section, muted trumpet, tenor sax soli, walking upright bass, ride cymbal swing, brushed snare, piano comping, live drum kit, analog tape warmth, room mic ambience, horn section punch, smoky nostalgia, suspended time, rubato intro, medium swing, call and response
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I met you by the washers
In a room that smelled like rain
Your sleeves were full of lint
And your grin was full of games

You fed that last coin in
Like you knew what it would say
It spun and spun and spun
Then it pointed me your way

[Pre-Chorus]
You said, "Don't look so shocked"
With a pocket full of stars
"Every tiny broken thing
Leaves a message where you are"

[Chorus]
Quarter machine oracle
Tell me what you see
Quarter machine oracle
Spin it back to me
If the answer's messy
Baby, let it be
Quarter machine oracle
You're the one for me (one for me)

[Verse 2]
You folded up my coat
Like it meant a little more
I watched your careful hands
By the vending machine door

A socks-and-soap kingdom
With a grin and a dare
You laughed at my bad luck
Then you fixed my tangled hair

[Pre-Chorus]
You said, "Hold on to the spin"
As it clattered down the line
"Some things only make sense
When they stumble into time"

[Chorus]
Quarter machine oracle
Tell me what you see
Quarter machine oracle
Spin it back to me
If the answer's messy
Baby, let it be
Quarter machine oracle
You're the one for me (one for me)

[Bridge]
One red sock, one blue
One of yours, one of mine
Every little broken pair
Found a better fit in time

[Chorus]
Quarter machine oracle
Tell me what you see
Quarter machine oracle
Spin it back to me
If the answer's messy
Baby, let it be
Quarter machine oracle
You're the one for me (one for me)
